items.title: AI Jensen Huang moonwalks as Michael Jackson; Musk: "RAM is so expensive"
items.summary: An 86-second AI deepfake from Bilibili creator Wang Yuyexing put Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang in Michael Jackson's 1992 Bucharest concert, with an AI crowd of tech CEOs (Sam Altman, Lisa Su, Tim Cook and others) and Bill Gates fainting onto a stretcher. It was reposted to X on October 5 and reportedly topped 5.4 million views in a day. Elon Musk replied "This is why RAM is so expensive," which turned it into a running joke about AI eating up memory chips and Huang's "world tour."

items.title: Mystery airplane box turns out to be a "W-IFE" unit
items.summary: A passenger posted a photo to r/whatisit of a device a flight attendant switched on in the overhead bin before takeoff. Commenters identified it as a Bluebox Wow portable wireless in-flight entertainment (W-IFE) system. The thread hit about 8,000 upvotes as people piled on with "wireless wife" jokes.
